name: Structural Load Estimation
description: Estimate dead, live, dynamic, wind, and seismic loads on civil structures per HL-93 / Eurocode.

name: Structural Steel Design
description: Size steel members (I-beams, trusses, plate girders) for bending, shear, buckling and fatigue.

name: Reinforced Concrete Design
description: Design reinforced and pre-stressed concrete members, decks, piers and abutments.

name: Cable-Stayed Bridge Systems
description: Layout pylons, cables and deck for cable-stayed crossings; cable tensioning sequences.

name: Truss Bridge Systems
description: Warren / Pratt / K-truss configurations; member sizing, connection design and span tables.

name: Arch Bridge Systems
description: Tied-arch and through-arch geometry, thrust line and rise-to-span ratio analysis.

name: Bridge Deck Design
description: Composite and orthotropic decks, slab thickness, lane width, drainage and wearing course.

name: Foundations and Piers
description: Pier sizing, pile groups, abutment design; bearing capacity and scour considerations.

name: Geotechnical Site Analysis
description: Subsurface investigation interpretation; soil bearing, settlement, slope stability for bridge sites.

name: Wind and Aero-Elastic Analysis
description: Static wind load, vortex shedding, flutter limits for long-span decks and pylons.

name: Seismic Analysis
description: Response-spectrum and pushover analysis for bridges; ductility detailing, isolation bearings.

name: Fatigue and Durability
description: S-N curve fatigue checks, weld category classification, corrosion protection and 50yr durability.

name: Numerical Validation
description: Sanity-check engineering arithmetic: span-to-depth, lane geometry, load arithmetic, unit consistency.

name: FEA Modelling Guidance
description: Recommend mesh, element types and boundary conditions for global bridge finite-element models.

name: Constructability Review
description: Erection sequencing, falsework strategy, segmental vs. cast-in-place, site logistics.

name: Materials Science for Civil Structures
description: Compare structural steel grades, weathering steel, HPC, UHPC, timber composites for durability and cost.

name: Cost Analysis
description: Quantity take-off, unit-cost build-up, contingencies and lifecycle cost reasoning.

name: Quantity Take-Off
description: Compute structural-steel tonnage, concrete volume, deck area from a conceptual design spec.

name: Lifecycle and Maintenance Planning
description: Inspection regimes, repaint cycles, deck-replacement intervals, NPV of maintenance.

name: Traffic and Load Modelling
description: Translate traffic counts (cars/h, truck %) into design live load per metre and lane factors.

name: Hydrology and River Engineering
description: Estimate design flood, scour depth, freeboard and span clearance over rivers.

name: Site and Geometry Planning
description: Choose bank locations, alignment, span layout and approach grade for a crossing.

name: Architectural Aesthetics
description: Bridge form, proportion, pylon shape, lighting and contextual harmony with the surrounding landscape.

name: Elevation Rendering
description: Draw schematic elevation views with span lines, pylons, deck profile and supports.

name: Schematic Diagramming
description: Produce clean engineering schematics with annotations, force arrows and cross-sections.

name: Color Palette Design
description: Pick palettes for engineering visuals: neutral background, accent for primary structure, warning for fail.

name: Bridge Lighting Design
description: Functional and architectural illumination for decks, pylons and pedestrian walkways.

name: Pedestrian and Cyclist Integration
description: Walkway widths, separation barriers, ramps and accessibility for non-motorised users.

name: Environmental Impact Assessment
description: Identify ecological constraints, embodied-carbon estimate, mitigation measures for bridge schemes.

name: Embodied Carbon Estimation
description: Compute kgCO2e per tonne / m3 for steel, concrete, timber; rank options by carbon footprint.

name: Eurocode Compliance
description: Cite relevant Eurocode clauses for bridge actions, ULS/SLS combinations and detailing.

name: AASHTO Compliance
description: Cite AASHTO LRFD clauses for highway bridge design, HL-93 live load and load combinations.

name: Technical Writing
description: Concise engineering prose for design briefs, basis of design, and conceptual proposals.

name: Executive Summary Drafting
description: Distil a multi-discipline conceptual design into a 1-page client-ready summary.

name: Risk Register Authoring
description: Identify, score and propose mitigations for technical, schedule and cost risks on bridge projects.

name: Applied Mathematics for Engineers
description: Beam theory, matrix structural analysis, optimisation and statistics for civil engineering problems.
